# GraphicRiver

> > GraphicRiver is a massive marketplace offering 832K+ fonts, logos, icons, and design templates starting from $2, featuring work from top creators and curated collections.

GraphicRiver is part of the Envato ecosystem and serves as a premier destination for digital designers to discover and purchase high-quality graphic assets including templates, stock graphics, and design add-ons. The platform connects independent creators with millions of designers seeking affordable, professional design resources.

- Graphic Assets Marketplace
- Fonts & Logos

## Browse & Discover

- [GraphicRiver Homepage](https://graphicriver.net): Main marketplace hub with 832K+ fonts, logos, icons & design templates from $2
- [Browse Categories](https://graphicriver.net/category): Category browser for graphics, mockups, illustrations, and design assets
- [Featured Files](https://graphicriver.net/feature): Curated collection of premium design templates and stock graphics

## Community & Collections

- [Personalized Feed](https://graphicriver.net/follow_feed): Follow designers and discover curated assets tailored to your interests
- [Public Collections](https://graphicriver.net/collections): User-curated collections of design assets across the marketplace
- [Top Authors](https://graphicriver.net/authors/top): Leaderboard showcasing top-performing designers and creators on the platform
